What to compare

Factor What to check Why it matters
Paper opacity Test a spare mark on a similar page when allowed Ink can show through thin stock
Correction method Compare erasing space with crossing out an entry Dense grids leave little room for changes

Pressure Use the lightest mark that remains readable Heavy pencil pressure can emboss later pages
